text:
Marathon Petroleum stock rose 0.69% today, continuing a strong nine-day rally that has gained 9.6% since mid-September. The rally tracks closely with U.S. oil prices climbing from the mid-$90s to $107 per barrel, and refineries running at 96.8% capacity—near maximum utilization. Higher crude oil prices and tight refinery capacity both improve margins for refiners, who profit from the spread between what they pay for crude and what they collect for selling gasoline and diesel.

Geopolitical tension in the Middle East—including reported incidents near Saudi Arabia's main airport and ongoing Houthi attacks—has kept oil prices elevated and markets wary of supply disruptions. At the same time, record diesel prices are straining the transportation sector, which raises long-term questions about demand, but for now the combination of high oil prices and constrained refinery capacity supports refiner profitability in the near term.
